description: Inspect and configure team role permissions: list_roles, get_role, set_role_permission, reset_role_permission. Roles are fixed (owner, admin, member) — owners always hold every permission and cannot be narrowed. Configurable permissions: registry:approve, registry:deprecate, team:manage_rbac, team:manage_sso. Requires the team:manage_rbac permission and Enterprise tier (rbac feature).

role.description: Role to inspect or configure (required except for list_roles)

name: rbac_manage
title: Manage RBAC Roles
